title: Apple Universal Links (AASA) & Android App Links Specification
description: Formal contract definition for validating Apple App Site Association (AASA) and Android Digital Asset Links (assetlinks.json) files, HTTPS hosting requirements, and URL path component pattern matching.

ERR_AASA_NOT_FOUND.title: Apple AASA File Unreachable
ERR_AASA_NOT_FOUND.description: The apple-app-site-association file is missing or returns a non-200 HTTP status code.

ERR_AASA_REDIRECT_FORBIDDEN.title: HTTP Redirect Forbidden on AASA
ERR_AASA_REDIRECT_FORBIDDEN.description: Apple CDN and iOS strictly forbid HTTP 301/302 redirects when fetching AASA files.

ERR_AASA_INVALID_JSON.title: Malformed AASA JSON
ERR_AASA_INVALID_JSON.description: The apple-app-site-association file is not valid JSON.

ERR_AASA_INVALID_APP_ID.title: Invalid Apple App ID Format
ERR_AASA_INVALID_APP_ID.description: AppID must consist of a 10-character Team ID followed by a dot and Bundle Identifier (e.g. ABCDE12345.com.example.app).

ERR_AASA_SIZE_EXCEEDED.title: AASA Exceeds Maximum Size Limit
ERR_AASA_SIZE_EXCEEDED.description: File exceeds Apple's 128KB limit for uncompressed AASA manifests.

ERR_ASSETLINKS_NOT_FOUND.title: Android AssetLinks File Missing
ERR_ASSETLINKS_NOT_FOUND.description: The /.well-known/assetlinks.json file is unreachable or returns a non-200 HTTP status.

ERR_ASSETLINKS_MISSING_RELATION.title: Missing Required AssetLinks Relation
ERR_ASSETLINKS_MISSING_RELATION.description: Android App Links require 'delegate_permission/common.handle_all_urls' in the relation array.

ERR_ASSETLINKS_INVALID_FINGERPRINT.title: Invalid SHA-256 Fingerprint Format
ERR_ASSETLINKS_INVALID_FINGERPRINT.description: Android certificate fingerprints must be 32 colon-separated two-digit uppercase hex values.

WARN_LEGACY_AASA_PATHS.title: Legacy Paths Array Used
WARN_LEGACY_AASA_PATHS.description: Using legacy 'paths' array instead of modern iOS 13+ 'components' dictionary with pattern matching.

WARN_CONTENT_TYPE_MISMATCH.title: Non-Standard Content-Type
WARN_CONTENT_TYPE_MISMATCH.description: Server returned text/plain or text/html instead of application/json.

INFO_ROUTE_MATCHED_APP.title: URL Successfully Routes to Native App
INFO_ROUTE_MATCHED_APP.description: The queried URL matches universal link pattern rules and will open inside the native application.

INFO_ROUTE_FALLS_BACK_WEB.title: URL Opens in Safari / Browser Fallback
INFO_ROUTE_FALLS_BACK_WEB.description: The queried URL does not match app route patterns or is explicitly excluded.
